messages:
Maya: Morning all — quick async check-in.

Maya: What I did: ran the nightly key-scan (KMS + IAM), validated vault alias configs, and started rotation for a couple of service accounts.

Maya: Blockers: svc-account `svc-ingest-prod` is failing rotation — blocked by missing iam:PassRole on the rotation role in staging. Trying to get the exact principal/err next.

Maya:
```
Error: AccessDenied: iam:PassRole denied for arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/kms-rotation-role
RequestID: f2a9c3b7-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-abcdef012345
```

Chris: @Maya can you paste the full principal? I can check perms quickly.

Maya: Principal: `arn:aws:iam::123456789:user/automation/ingest-creator`. We attempted `sts:AssumeRole` into `kms-rotation-role`, the call that then tries to call `iam:PassRole` fails.

Priya: I’ll take this. Assigning to me — ETA ~2h to verify and open a perms PR if needed. @Sam can you look out for an infra PR?

Sam: yep — I already started a small PR to add `iam:PassRole` for the `rotation-runner` role in infra (safe-scoped). PR #4521: https://git.company/infra/iam/pull/4521 :thumbsup:

Jordan: quick FYI — static audit bubbled up a related finding: several KMS aliases missing the `rotated=true` tag. Not a blocker for the immediate rotation but want to clean up tags to avoid noisy alerts.

Maya: please go ahead @Jordan. If you tag them I’ll re-run the key-scan and confirm reduction in findings.

infra-bot: nightly-key-scan completed — findings: 3 (medium:2, low:1). Full report: https://s3.company/reports/keyscan/3891012345.html

sre-bot: scheduled job `rotation-runner` will re-run in 30m. If PR #4521 is merged it will pick up changes. Monitoring window: 1h after run.

Priya: updating here — I see the missing `iam:PassRole` at the role trust level. Drafting a minimal change and a short playbook for the deploy. Will include canary steps for staging.

Sam: I can merge the PR and trigger the deploy once Priya posts the playbook.

Priya: posted the IAM diff in the PR description and added a short checklist. Canaries: 1) run rotation in `staging-us-west-2` for `svc-ingest-stg`, 2) verify KMS operation logs, 3) roll forward.

Sam: merging PR now and kicking off CI. Build: `ci/iam/rotation-runner #678`.

Sam: merged — deploy job started. Link: https://ci.company/build/678 :rocket:

Maya: thanks team. I’ll re-run the scan after the deploy completes and post updated findings here. If anything blocks the canary I’ll tag @Chris for infra escalation.

Chris: ack, available if needed.

Jordan: proceeding with tagging run for the stale aliases, will post results.

Maya: plan for today: finish the re-scan, close two medium findings, document remediation steps in Confluence (link to follow), and confirm staging rotation succeeded. If anything unexpected comes up I’ll escalate.

Priya: noted, will update this thread with the playbook and any weird perms edgecases I find.

Maya: /eod — will post final when scan is done (~45m).
